NBA DFS Picks for Sunday, November 1 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 4 games · First game 3:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 1, 3:05 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) is the top-projected player on the Sunday, November 1 DraftKings main slate at 56.2 DraftKings points for $12,300. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.6, $10,100) and Scottie Barnes (TOR, 45.5, $8,700) are next.

Nolan Traore (BKN) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.88 projected points per $1,000 at $4,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 1, 3:05 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
